certik/dftatom.manifest:
name = "dftatom"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "MIT"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true

scope: Unmodified Fortran library sources selected from the upstream native makefile and wrapped for FPM. The checked example adapts the upstream hydrogen test to Z=1 and computes all six (n,l) states through n=3 on an exponential radial mesh. It requires solver convergence, finite energies and agreement with the analytical nonrelativistic energies -1/(2*n**2) within 1e-7 Hartree. Relativistic Dirac, Poisson and self-consistent density-functional calculations are present in the library but not exercised by this example. C/Python bindings and optional extra integration/interpolation/LAPACK sources are outside the selected native source set.
